verdict.rationale: Omnara lets an organization connect providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Bedrock, self-hosted), configure specific models, and grant them to projects, and agents are defined by a YAML config. This implies you can pin a chosen model, but no evidence describes an automatic model-selection mode or a way to switch from it. Missing for 10: any documented automatic model selection to switch away from, explicit per-agent model field or override docs, hands-on corroboration.
